title: CALDER & ROWE
description: Hard decisions, argued well. A small law firm's page that is a bound brief being drafted: a pinned memorandum writes itself word by word as you scroll, margin notes arrive in gold, and filing a matter presses the firm's seal onto a docket number.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · React 19 · SVG · Lenis

sections.title: Hero
sections.summary: (midnight, min-height 100svh): gold-hairline colonnade line-art behind, eyebrow "New York — Business law · Disputes · Estates", h1 "Hard decisions, *argued well.*" (two masked lines, the second in gold italic), lead "Calder & Rowe is a New York law firm of eleven attorneys. When the matter is consequential, you work directly with the partners who argue it.", a magnetic gold pill "File a matter" and a text link "Read how we argue". On the right, a tilted ivory **memorandum sheet** (header "MEMORANDUM OF COUNSEL · No. 87-0412", "In the matter of *your decision*", two numbered clauses with ghost text lines, a gold chip "Settle before discovery.", a signature line) over a parchment back sheet, with the turning seal overlapping its corner. A four-up strip: Direct line, Offices (Manhattan · Brooklyn · Westchester), Since 1987, Reply within one business day.

sections.title: Matters
sections.summary: (§ I, ivory): "Four kinds of matter, *argued by partners.*" and four cards, each a count: I Business formation & contracts, II Commercial disputes, III Employment & executive matters, IV Trusts & estates. Each has a ghost Roman numeral, a summary, three typical matters with gold diamond bullets, and an "Ask about this" link that pre-selects the matter in the form.

sections.title: The argument
sections.summary: (§ II, midnight): the mechanic below. Four stages: Intake, Analysis, Position, Resolution, mapped to four clauses (Statement of facts, Questions presented, Recommended course, Disposition), each with a gold margin note ("Your call is answered by a partner.", "Usually two or three issues, rarely more.", "Fixed-fee quote included.", "A status note every Friday.").
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: Counsel
sections.summary: (§ III, ivory): "The people who *answer the phone.*", two partner cards (Mara Calder, founding partner, commercial disputes; Daniel Rowe, partner, corporate & estates) with 4:5 portrait slots, a short bio and credential pills, then four count-up facts: 38 years in practice, 11 attorneys in one office, 2 partners on every matter, 1 business day to reply.

sections.title: Authorities
sections.summary: (§ IV, midnight): a large client quote ("Mara gave us a plan we could understand and act on. We felt *represented from the first call.*") with attribution, three anonymised matters written as citation cards (`No. 21-0388`, Founder buy-out, resolved in eleven weeks…), an advertising disclaimer, and a slow marquee of matter types.

sections.title: Questions
sections.summary: (§ V, ivory): five questions in an accordion (first consultation, fees, individuals vs businesses, confidentiality, where we meet) beside a sticky heading.

sections.title: File a matter
sections.summary: (§ VI, midnight): "Bring us the *hard one.*", the phone, email and Chambers (130 Madison Avenue, 12th Floor, New York, NY 10016), and an ivory form card: name, email, kind of matter (the four counts plus "Not sure yet"), message (10–600 characters). Pill inputs with floating labels. Client-side validation only, no network request.

sections.title: Footer
sections.summary: (ink): logo, one line, explore links, chambers, an oversized outlined "Calder & Rowe" wordmark in gold at 38%, and the line "Attorney advertising. Prior results do not guarantee a similar outcome."
